head: 32d77a51e556de60d6dc0daf871a442becc709c5
requirement_catalog_note: REQUIREMENTS.md and requirements-traceability-crosswalk.csv contain no diagram REQ-*. Findings bind requirement_id=GAP. Status follows file/command proof.

findings.observation: 26 supplemental 90-pkg class diagrams differ from the AST generator, and 90-pkg-application-services-ops.mmd is stale; the nightly check that would catch this is hard-disabled.
findings.method: python scripts/diagrams/render/generate_package_family_class_diagrams.py --check @ 2026-09-25T08:45:00Z exit:1; difflib of expected vs committed text; read .github/workflows/architecture-docs-nightly.yml:38-39
findings.expected: Committed 90-pkg text matches generator output, and architecture-docs-nightly runs --check.
findings.actual: Families 104, slices 126, changed 26, stale 1. health @nodes 26 still lists namespace observability_backend_startup_types; generator emits @nodes 9. composite runner part2 @nodes 12 vs 22 (missing merge/stage mixins). ops.mmd is outside the expected set; part1/part2 are missing. Nightly step is `if: ${{ false }}`.
findings.impact: Package-family class maps used as component inventory omit current classes and still show removed modules.
findings.remediation: Regenerate 90-pkg from generate_package_family_class_diagrams.py and re-enable the nightly --check after the refresh.
findings.automation: architecture-docs-nightly.yml step is present but if:false; docs.yml intentionally does not run this check.
findings.root_cause: generated package-family class diagrams diverge from AST and the nightly check is hard-disabled

findings.observation: Multiline ELK init is invisible to LAYOUT checks, and apply-elk --dry-run plans to insert elk_init into 17 architecture diagrams that already set layout elk.
findings.method: check_layout_policy(01-high-level-hexagonal.mmd) @ 2026-09-25T08:42:00Z uses=False has_elk=False issues=[]; python -m scripts.diagrams apply-elk --dry-run exit:0 Modified:17 Skipped already ELK:0
findings.expected: A %%{init} block with layout elk and @nodes>40 is recognized; dry-run does not plan a second init.
findings.actual: 01-high-level-hexagonal.mmd:12-22 is a multiline init with 'layout': 'elk' and @nodes 46. The first non-comment line is inside the block, so flowchart policy returns false. has_elk_init requires %%{init}, layout, and elk on one line (apply_elk_layout.py:101-107, lint_diagrams.py:1033-1035).
findings.impact: LAYOUT-002 cannot see pretty-printed ELK blocks. apply-elk without --dry-run would rewrite compliant canonical sources.
findings.remediation: Parse the whole %%{init}...%% block before deciding flowchart vs ELK. Do not run apply-elk without --dry-run until that detector matches multiline init.
findings.automation: LAYOUT-001/002 in lint_diagrams.py; apply-elk --dry-run is the audit command in ADR-040 D8.
findings.root_cause: ELK init detection requires init, layout, and elk on a single line

findings.observation: EXEC and MAINT are reported as orphans even though lines 64-65 are labelled dotted edges to BPR and BSRV.
findings.expected: Mermaid `ID -. label .-> ID` counts as an edge. --check exit 0 for this file.
findings.actual: _ARROW_RE matches contiguous `-.->` only (prune_orphan_nodes.py:101-104). --check flags EXEC, MAINT in the .mmd and in views/28-composition-root-di-graph-full.mermaid. --fix removes definition lines of flagged ids.
findings.impact: Pre-commit prune-orphan-diagram-nodes fails on a connected DI graph. --fix would drop the EXEC/MAINT node labels while leaving the edges.
findings.remediation: Teach the arrow scanner the labelled form `-. text .->` before any --fix. Do not grandfather or delete EXEC/MAINT.
findings.automation: .pre-commit-config.yaml prune-orphan-diagram-nodes; GRAPH-001 delegates to the same parser.
findings.root_cause: orphan scanner misses labelled dotted flowchart edges

findings.observation: Two sequence participants are declared and never used as message endpoints.
findings.method: prune_orphan_nodes.py --check --json orphan_ids Profiles and PR; read of both sequence bodies
findings.expected: Every participant appears in at least one message, or is marked %% keep-orphan.
findings.actual: Profiles (line 14) has no message; the note on line 40 only mentions the alias text. PR (foundation/38-runtime-assembly-sequence.mmd:26) is never a message actor; PipelineRunner is only a return label.
findings.impact: Sequence views show actors that are outside the drawn call flow.
findings.remediation: Add the missing messages or remove the unused participants. Do not treat this as the EXEC/MAINT false positive.
findings.root_cause: sequence participants are declared without messages

findings.observation: check_orphan_nodes swallows ImportError and returns no issues, so script-mode lint reports a false green for GRAPH-001 when the scripts package is not importable.
findings.method: lint corpus without PYTHONPATH @ 2026-09-25T08:40:00Z GRAPH-001=0 exit:0; same command with PYTHONPATH=repo GRAPH-001=4 exit:0; script-mode sys.path simulation ModuleNotFoundError: No module named scripts
findings.expected: Failure to load the orphan parser is a lint error.
findings.actual: except ImportError: return []. docs.yml runs python3 scripts/diagrams/lint/lint_diagrams.py after uv sync, so CI may still import scripts; that CI import was not re-executed here.
findings.impact: A local lint invocation that matches the workflow command but lacks an installed package hides orphan warnings.
findings.remediation: Fail lint when the prune parser cannot be imported. Do not return an empty issue list.
findings.root_cause: diagram lint swallows ImportError and skips GRAPH-001

findings.observation: Silver and Quarantine styles use hex values that ADR-040 assigns to other roles.
findings.method: read foundation/12-local-deployment-architecture.mmd:69-72 against ADR-040 D1 table; corpus lint COLOUR-001 count 0
findings.actual: Line 70 Silver fill #f1f5f9 (External fill) stroke #475569. Line 71 Quarantine stroke #dc2626 (Infrastructure stroke) fill #ffe4e6. Both hexes are inside the allowed palette, so COLOUR-001 does not fire.
findings.impact: Local-deployment colours blur External/Infrastructure with Silver/Quarantine. The drawn topology still says local-only, in-process lock, filesystem outputs.
findings.remediation: Set Silver fill to #f8fafc and Quarantine stroke to #e11d48. Role checks are separate from palette membership.
findings.root_cause: layer style uses another ADR-040 role hex
